documents: AMSID IDD v0.1 (Copy_of_AMSID_IDD_v_0_1.xlsm), sheets SVAA P375, Items and Valid Sets
SVA Data Catalogue Volume 1: Data Interfaces, Appendix A (Data Interface Index) and Appendix B (Data Interface Definition), 01/04/2026 - Version 66.0
source.scope: P0278-P0320 and P0323-P0342: the 16 P375 flows in the IDD plus the related MSID Pair (P344), daily activations (CP1517), ABSVD (P354), other P375, baselining (P376) and non-final/non-chargeable demand flows.
source.note: Generated from the source documents. Wording is as in the sources; whitespace was trimmed.

conventions.structureSource: 'AMSID IDD v0.1' = groups/items/types from the IDD flow sheet; 'SVA Data Catalogue Appendix B' = data items from the catalogue, where record structure, optionality and types are not given
conventions.routes: From Appendix A: source document (BSCP, or the technical specification / known-as name where Appendix A gives one), From role, To role, version
conventions.mandatory: true/false from the IDD ('1' / 'O'); null where the source does not say
conventions.cardinality: IDD record-group occurrences (min/max, max null = unbounded); null for catalogue-only flows
conventions.dataType: IDD flow-sheet type; for catalogue-only flows, the IDD Items-sheet type of an item with the same name where one exists (dataTypeSource says which)
conventions.validSet: name of an entry in validSets; validSetLinkedBy says how it was linked
conventions.family: grouping used in this file, by flow number; introducedBy is the change named in the first version-history entry, where the catalogue gives one
conventions.catalogue: what Appendix B says about the flow: name, version, data group, notes, route comments, version history; for IDD flows also its data-item list, compared in reconciliation
conventions.reconciliation: IDD against catalogue: differing name/version, and item names found in only one of the two (case-insensitive)
conventions.observationsForReview: possible inconsistencies noticed in the catalogue; not corrected
